subject: Mobile Development
title: Open Source in Mobile Development
description: A quick win: understand Open Source in Mobile Development.

hook.text: React Native, Flutter, and Android itself are all open source. Free tools built by billions of dollars.

buildup.text: Companies open-source their mobile tools to attract developers and grow their ecosystems.

discovery.text: Open source reduces development costs and lets the community fix bugs and add features.

twist.text: Companies control the roadmap. If Google or Meta deprioritize a project, the community scrambles.

climax.text: Open source powers modern mobile development but depends on corporate sponsorship to thrive.

punchline.text: Free tools aren't free — corporations fund them.

quiz.question: Why do companies open-source their mobile tools?
options: To attract developers and grow their ecosystem
